messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — NebulaRetail account showing a sharp usage drop: ~70% WoW on API calls. Renewal scheduled in 6 weeks. Procurement looped in a new contact (K. Olsen) and mentioned a short competitor pilot. Can we triage risk and coordinate next steps? :warning:
Jon Alvarez: thanks for flagging — do we have MAU/DAU and seat activity by team? Also any recent billing or SSO changes?
Maya Chen: quick snapshot from last 30d: total API calls 42k -> 12k (week over week). Active seats down 35%. No billing alerts. They did a role audit last week and handed procurement to K. Olsen.
Leo Park: tagging infra — any throttling/latency spikes in logs that could explain client-side retries?
Maya Chen: nothing obvious in error budget. Latency stable. I pulled last 72h traces — most calls are successful but prefix cache hit rate dropped on a handful of routes.
Leo Park: could be model variant mismatch — if they switched to streaming client and our prefix caching config isn't aligned it can drop effective throughput. I'll run a quick health check on their routes.
Priya Singh: recommendation: schedule a focused enablement call with K. Olsen + technical champion this week. Share a 1-pager with quick wins (batching, client SDK config, dashboard walkthrough). I'll draft the one-pager. :memo:
Jon Alvarez: I'll reach out to K. Olsen and push for a 30-min sync. I'll offer a canary demo of our cost/latency improvements.
Maya Chen: good — also want to capture feedback about the competitor pilot ask. If they need feature parity we should know which endpoints/features they're testing.
Jon Alvarez: noted. I'll probe which vendor and which features.
Leo Park: health check results (quick):
```
Route: /v1/generate
Window: 72h
Avg latency: 220ms
5xx rate: 0.1%
Prefix cache hit: 12% (expected ~68%)
Top user agent: nebula-retail-internal/2.3.1
```
Leo Park: low cache hit looks actionable. Suggest temporary policy: enable aggressive prefix caching for their org and bump batch size to reduce token cost during demo.
Maya Chen: can we do that without breaking other tenants?
Leo Park: yes — we'll scope to org-id and rollout as a canary for NebulaRetail only. I can push a policy change this afternoon and monitor.
Priya Singh: once policy is live, I'll run a short enablement session showing them the dashboard metrics to watch. Also propose a reuse checklist for their engineers to avoid client misconfig that kills cache.
Jon Alvarez: I'll coordinate commercial message: propose an interim extension on Dedicated trial + a short competitive-readiness package (free enablement + 1:1 onboarding). Might help stall pilot.
Maya Chen: perfect. Let's also prepare two one-click rollback plans in case latency/regressions pop up.
Leo Park: will prepare rollback and monitoring playbook.
RenewalBot: AUTOMATED ALERT — renewal at 6 weeks. Risk level: elevated (usage drop + procurement change). Recommended actions: immediate enablement call, tech canary, commercial nudge.
Maya Chen: thanks RenewalBot. Owners: Maya (CS lead, PM for engagement), Jon (AM/exec sponsor), Leo (tech lead), Priya (enablement). Next milestones:
- Today EOD: Leo to apply org-scoped caching policy and report results (ts 4298765460)
- Tomorrow: Priya share one-pager and schedule enablement session (ts 4298765600)
- 48h: Jon to confirm pilot vendor details and secure a sync with K. Olsen (ts 4298765899)
Maya Chen: anyone object to that plan?
Jon Alvarez: good plan, I'll draft outreach and keep the ask tight (30m + agenda).
Priya Singh: I'll include a simple checklist and the dashboard link.
Leo Park: policy change queued — will post results in this thread once live. :rocket:
Maya Chen: thanks team. I'll update the renewal playbook entry and attach the one-pager after Priya drafts it. If we can stabilize usage, we reduce churn risk significantly. :crossed_fingers:
